text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF CHRONIC MYELOID LEUKAEMIA (CML)
Clinical Features
- Asymptomatic Abdominal swelling/pain, Lethargy
- Shortness of breath on exertion
- Weight loss
- Unexplained haemorrhage at various sites e.g. gums, intestinal/urinary
tracts
- Increased sweating
- Visual disturbances
- Gout
- Priapism
- Splenomegaly
- Anaemia and Haemorrhage
- Fever
- Lymphadenopathy (rare in chronic phase)
